documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 27% year-on-year and EBITDA growing 55% year-on-year. The company's construction equipment segment continues to show strong momentum, while the large agricultural equipment segment remains subdued but is expected to recover in calendar year 2027. Management highlighted that Mexico operations are on track for first customer deliveries in Q3 of this year, and they continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities with a robust net cash position of INR 190 crores. Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth and a 55% increase in EBITDA for Q1 FY27, exceeding its annual guidance. Management highlighted that infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining momentum in the construction equipment segment, while the large agriculture segment is expected to reach a cyclical bottom in CY2026.

guidance.claim: The company expects its FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 performance to be in line with Q1.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Mexico operations are expected to generate mid-single-digit million dollar revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering a margin of over 20% plus for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: Warehousing sales are expected to remain in the range of 52% to 56% over the next 12 to 18 months.
guidance.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%. And I think that's where we foresee this to remain in the next, let's say, 12 to 18 months.

guidance.claim: The company's Q1 FY27 performance exceeded the annual guidance previously provided.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: A meaningful recovery in the large agriculture segment is anticipated in CY2027.
guidance.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth in FY27 to match the growth rate achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins comfortably above 20% as volumes increase in FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

guidance.claim: Revenue for the first quarter of FY27 is expected to be consistent with the fourth quarter of FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the construction equipment segment has continued into Q1 of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with calendar year 2026 representing the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment in India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket business was flat year-on-year in absolute terms due to tariff-driven price volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms. The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure spending in the US and Europe is supporting healthy order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture growth in Western markets is currently measured due to economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured. Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is observing an encouraging recovery in unit volumes for small agriculture after three years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The large agriculture segment remains subdued across the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand was affected by price volatility driven by tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: The global agriculture and construction equipment cycles are beginning to show signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to strengthen throughout FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural machinery is currently at a cyclical low, with recovery expected to build through the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market is showing early signs of recovery after passing its cyclical low.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's organic capex requirements are typically about 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: I think overall, if you see, even after having done that, today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is closely looking at about half a dozen acquisition opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to begin customer deliveries from its Mexico warehouse in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts is investing in the growth of its construction and large agricultural equipment business lines.
capex_expansion.quote: We are continuing to invest in growing our construction and large agricultural equipment businesses, given that small ag is already a segment where we hold significant global market share.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to maintain annual capital expenditure between 2.5% and 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts is rebuilding a facility in Ludhiana following a fire incident in the finishing shop.
capex_expansion.quote: In order to ensure continuity of supplies, we swiftly implemented interim arrangements, primarily leveraging our subsidiary operations and to a limited extent, select external partners. I am happy to share that these measures enabled uninterrupted support to our customers with minimal disruption. And in parallel, the rebuilding effort is well underway.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested in a warehousing and nearshoring model in Mexico.
capex_expansion.quote: And we've also continued to build out our warehousing or nearshoring model with the investment in Mexico that we've done, right?

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 90 crores, registering 55% growth year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials was 33.3% due to product mix change and a small inventory gain.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change. There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The company's typical material cost is in the range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The company is confident of maintaining a 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We are also very confident of maintaining our 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a gross profit margin of 66.6% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6%

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA margin for the first quarter stood at 23.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Operating EBITDA Margin(%) (As % of Revenue from Ops) 23.6%

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts achieved an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs have normalized to 35%, within the company's expected range.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material costs are generally passed through to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a dominant share of business globally in the below 70 HP three-point linkage segment.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you look at in the below 70 HP three-point linkage, we have a dominant share of business globally, right? And we continue to win new business in this segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a single-digit market share in the above 70 HP three-point linkage segment.
orders_capacity.quote: In the above 70 HP three-point linkage, where like we've just discussed on the call, we are at a single-digit market share.

orders_capacity.claim: The new business order book for the trailing twelve months exceeds INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: New business wins over the last 12 months exceeded INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's revenue is now evenly split between 3-point linkage and precision machine parts.
orders_capacity.quote: And that's why you see that today, your revenue from 3PL and PMP is almost 50-50 split.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books showed sequential improvement in the final quarter of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated INR 44 crores of operating cash during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a net cash position of INR 190 crore as of the end of Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is net debt-free with a cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed a total dividend of INR 170 crores for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital improved to 136 days by the end of the fiscal year.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital is 136 days on our trailing 12-month revenue as of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects a mid-teens decline in the large agricultural industry this year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket business.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic uncertainty and volatility are causing consumers to defer purchases of big-ticket equipment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation is a current challenge for supply chain discipline.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains. Our teams have navigated this with discipline, working closely with vendors and ensuring that our delivery commitments were met without disruption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical escalation in West Asia has caused supply chain uncertainty and increased input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action. Our teams responded with agility, putting alternate arrangements in place rapidly to ensure uninterrupted customer supplies. While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America are currently declining in the mid-to-high teens.
risks_headwinds.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company is going to deliver FY27 comfortably over the 20% plus margin.
management_commitments.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical is expected to become a meaningful vertical in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Warehousing sales are expected to remain in the range of 52% to 56% in the next 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%. And I think that's where we foresee this to remain in the next, let's say, 12 to 18 months.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in the third quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects a more meaningful recovery in the large agriculture segment through CY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 levels.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to bring the Ludhiana facility back to normal operations on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to keep capex within the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
